title: Adventures in New Guinea

The opening of the book sets the stage for Chalmers's adventures, explaining the geopolitical context of New Guinea and the missionaries' efforts to establish a Christian presence there. The text describes his observations of the native lifestyle, rituals, and challenges, along with the environmental aspects of the region.
